name: UGC Phase 4 — Delivery (Google Docs + ClickUp + Client)

parameters.content:
## WORKFLOW 4: DELIVERY

Webhook POST /ugc-delivery with { project_id, action, script_ids, notes }

IF action = approve:
1. Read approved scripts from Airtable
2. Format scripts (same formatting logic as original)
3. Write to Google Docs
4. Update ClickUp tasks
5. Update Project status to Delivered
6. Update script records (overall_status: Delivered)
7. Slack notification to PM + channel
8. Log to Google Sheets
9. Respond to webhook

IF action = reject:
1. Store revision notes in Airtable
2. Trigger re-write (HTTP request back to Workflow 3)
3. Slack notification

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { body: { project_id: 'rec_TEST_123', action: 'approve', script_ids: [], notes: '' } } }];

parameters.content:
## APPROVE BRANCH
Format scripts -> Google Docs -> ClickUp
-> Update Airtable -> Slack -> Log -> Respond

parameters.jsCode:
// ============================================================
// Format approved scripts for Google Docs output
// Same formatting logic as original workflow
// ============================================================

const data = $input.first().json;
const project = data.project;
const scripts = data.scripts;
const scriptIds = data.script_ids || [];
const brandName = project.brand_name || project.fields?.brand_name || 'Brand';
const clientCode = project.client_code || project.fields?.client_code || 'N/A';
const clientName = project.client_name || project.fields?.client_name || 'Client';
const qaQuality = 'N/A';

// Filter to specific script_ids if provided, otherwise use all
const selectedScripts = scriptIds.length > 0
  ? scripts.filter(s => scriptIds.includes(s.id))
  : scripts;

const formattedScripts = selectedScripts.map((s, i) => {
  const d = s.fields || s;
  const num = d.script_number || (i + 1);
  const onScreenText = d.on_screen_text || '';

  const docContent = [
    `${brandName} | UGC Script #${num}`,
    `${'='.repeat(50)}`,
    '',
    `CONCEPT: ${d.concept_name || 'N/A'}`,
    `FORMAT: ${d.format || 'UGC'}`,
    `DURATION: ${d.estimated_duration || '30 sec'}`,
    `QA SCORE: ${d.qa_score || 'N/A'}/10`,
    '',
    `${'='.repeat(50)}`,
    'HOOK (0-3 sec)',
    `${'='.repeat(50)}`,
    d.hook || '',
    '',
    `${'='.repeat(50)}`,
    'HOOK REINFORCEMENT (3-5 sec)',
    `${'='.repeat(50)}`,
    d.hook_reinforcement || '',
    '',
    `${'='.repeat(50)}`,
    'PROBLEM (5-10 sec)',
    `${'='.repeat(50)}`,
    d.problem || '',
    '',
    `${'='.repeat(50)}`,
    'SOLUTION (10-18 sec)',
    `${'='.repeat(50)}`,
    d.solution || '',
    '',
    `${'='.repeat(50)}`,
    'PROOF (18-25 sec)',
    `${'='.repeat(50)}`,
    d.proof || '',
    '',
    `${'='.repeat(50)}`,
    'CTA (25-30 sec)',
    `${'='.repeat(50)}`,
    d.cta || '',
    '',
    `${'='.repeat(50)}`,
    'FULL SCRIPT (for creator)',
    `${'='.repeat(50)}`,
    d.full_script || '',
    '',
    `${'='.repeat(50)}`,
    'VISUAL DIRECTION',
    `${'='.repeat(50)}`,
    d.visual_direction || '',
    '',
    'ON-SCREEN TEXT:',
    onScreenText,
    '',
    'CREATOR NOTES:',
    d.creator_notes || '',
    '',
    'THUMBNAIL FRAME:',
    d.thumbnail_frame || '',
    '',
    `${'='.repeat(50)}`,
    `Generated by Smashed Agency UGC Script Agent Team`,
    `Client: ${clientCode} | ${new Date().toISOString()}`
  ].join('\n');

  return {
    script_id: s.id,
    script_number: num,
    concept_name: d.concept_name || 'Concept ' + num,
    format: d.format || 'UGC',
    hook: d.hook || '',
    full_script: d.full_script || '',
    doc_content: docContent,
    estimated_duration: d.estimated_duration || '30 sec'
  };
});

return [{
  json: {
    project_id: data.project_id,
    project,
    brand_name: brandName,
    client_code: clientCode,
    client_name: clientName,
    scripts: formattedScripts,
    script_ids: selectedScripts.map(s => s.id),
    total_scripts: formattedScripts.length
  }
}];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ requests: [{ insertText: { location: { index: 1 }, text: $json.doc_content } }] }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', action: 'delivered', project_id: $json.project_id || $('Format Approved Scripts').first().json.project_id, brand: $json.brand_name, client_code: $json.client_code, scripts_delivered: $json.total_scripts, message: 'Scripts delivered to Google Docs, ClickUp, and Airtable. Client notified.' }) }}
